name: Anri
source:
Braven's partner, though she serves in a supporting role.

In Viper-V12 ("Future Investigator Bravan" story), the Donages single Anri out as the perfect target to lure Braven into a trap.

In Viper-F50, Anri plays a more active role in the narrative, breaking away from the "damsel in distress" archetype of the previous story.
